## New resource questions

<!-- For corrections to existing entries, remove this section. For additions, answer every question with concrete details. Read CONTRIBUTING.md first. -->

1. What did you try or read? Describe a typography task you completed and its result, or something you learned. State any limitations, including payment or account requirements. Include links that support your claims.
2. What does this offer that existing entries do not? Name the entries you compared it with and explain the difference.
3. What is your relationship to this resource? State if you own or maintain it, work for its publisher, receive sponsorship, or benefit financially from it. Otherwise, write "None".
